0.original: Osment at Crescent Cove is vexed by litter in the area.

1.original: A merchant from Limsa Lominsa has left rubbish scattered about the docks. Clean it up as a service to the distressed Osment.

2.original: You have finished cleaning up the rubbish that littered the docks. Speak to Osment once more.

3.original: Though cleanliness has been restored, Osment is already lamenting the next Lominsan sloth who will darken his docks.

24.original: Clean up the rubbish on the docks.

48.original: Ugggh, what a pain in the bloody arse. Who do those Lominsans think they are, anyway?

49.original: Just look at all this, would you? A merchant from Limsa Lominsa dumped this junk when he shipped out. Claimed it wasn't fit for sellin', so he just up and left it!

50.original: Barbarians! What passes for etiquette across the Strait of Merlthor?

51.original: Don't suppose I could ask you to clean up the rest for me, eh? Please? I've picked up so much junk already, the mere sight of it fair makes me gag.

52.original: Thank you, friend. Seeing this place clean again does my spirit good.

53.original: Though, I suppose some other Lominsan merchant will be by before long and leave more filth behind. <sigh> I hate my life.
